children: OPI nail polish owner Wella Company has filed for a U.S. initial public offering, the firm said in a regulatory filing on Monday.
The company said it intends to list on the NYSE under the symbol 'WELA'.
Reuters reported earlier this year that the firm, which  also owns Wella hair products, had been working with investment banks to prepare for the IPO.
Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, KKR, and J.P. Morgan are among the underwriters to the offering.
